Helicone — LLM observability proxy

helicone/proxy · version 1

envs add helicone/proxy

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
HELICONE_API_KEY required secret Helicone states nothing about client-side use, so it is secret here, and the shape it stands in front of makes that the right way round: it proxies your model calls, so a published key lets a stranger route spend and logs through your project.. where to get it
